summary: An LTP subscription: the LTP-type packet (last traded price and trade time) streams as an LTP frame.

notes: The LTP subscription type carries the last traded price only (hdfcsky_mapping.py docstring); the packet's other MBP fields are proto3 defaults.

deviations.reason: The LTP-type packet carries no close (proto3 writes closingPrice 0); the web sends close and prev_close as 0.0 instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376). Lead decision: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out, web defect.

HDFC Securities sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).

The LTP-type packet carries no close (proto3 writes closingPrice 0); the web sends close and prev_close as 0.0 instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376). Lead decision: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out, web defect.
